heroHeadline: IFT-12 WDR Complete — NET May 19 Locked (T-3); Artemis II Crew Returns to JSC After Canada Tour (Day 36)
heroSubtitle: May 16: SpaceX's Starship IFT-12 (Starship V3 debut — Booster 19 + Ship 39) completed its full-stack Wet Dress Rehearsal (WDR) at Orbital Launch Pad 2, Starbase, clearing the vehicle for final pre-launch countdown operations. The NET May 19 launch window at 5:30 PM CDT (22:30 UTC) remains locked with no slips; the window extends through May 21. IFT-12 is a critical Artemis III milestone: Ship 39 will be the first Starship to test the docking port and propellant-transfer hardware that will eventually enable orbital refueling of the Starship Human Landing System (HLS) for the Artemis IV crewed lunar landing. All four Artemis II crew members — Commander Reid Wiseman, Pilot Victor Glover, Mission Specialist Christina Koch, and Canadian Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen (CSA) — returned to NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston on May 16 following the conclusion of their three-city Canada tour (Ottawa May 13, CSA HQ Saint-Hubert May 14, Montreal Place des Arts May 15). Day 36 post-splashdown: the Orion crew module heat shield visual inspection continues at KSC's Multi-Payload Processing Facility, with formal Marshall X-ray scans and Avcoat sample extractions on track for summer 2026. Artemis III SLS core stage stacking advances in VAB High Bay 2. Artemis Accords at 67 nations.
